verdict.rationale: GrowthBook publishes a public pricing page with named tiers (Starter/Pro/Enterprise-style) showing per-tier feature gates, seat limits (e.g., 'Up to 3 users', '1 project') and explicit statements that feature flags, experiments, and traffic are unlimited, which tells a PM that usage volume isn't a cost driver — but there is no breakdown of MAU-based, event-based, or request-based pricing tiers or calculators, and no per-tier dollar figures are shown in evidence. missing for 10: explicit dollar pricing figures per tier, any MAU/event/request cost-driver explanation (since usage appears unlimited but this isn't explicitly framed as a pricing driver), and independent confirmation of pricing accuracy.
